<thought>Based on the six measured resistances, the only topology that satisfies all pairwise values is a simple series chain (a path) connecting the four nodes in the order X2 – Nc1 – Nc2 – B. The three resistors are therefore:
- R1 (10 Ω) between X2 and Nc1
- R2 (15 Ω) between Nc1 and Nc2
- R3 (20 Ω) between Nc2 and B

This matches all given measurements:
B‑Nc2 = 20 Ω, B‑Nc1 = 20+15 = 35 Ω, B‑X2 = 20+15+10 = 45 Ω,
Nc1‑Nc2 = 15 Ω, Nc1‑X2 = 10 Ω, Nc2‑X2 = 15+10 = 25 Ω.</thought>
